summary: Iteration 10 - Package Category feature testing. Backend: 63/63 tests pass (added 3 new tests: create+update category, empty default, public catalog exposes category). Frontend: Packages admin page shows filter chips 'ALL (6) | BULK PARTY (2) | CORPORATE (2) | KIDS SPECIAL (1) | WEEKEND (1)' with data-testid=pkg-filter-{cat}. Clicking 'Kids Special' filters grid (only Kids Birthday Bash shows, GOLD hidden). Clicking ALL restores full list. Category pill visible top-right of each card (CORPORATE, KIDS SPECIAL, BULK PARTY, WEEKEND). Add Package dialog contains data-testid=pkg-category input with placeholder 'e.g. Kids Special, Corporate, Weekend Combo' and list=pkg-cat-suggest; datalist has 4 options ['BULK PARTY','Corporate','Kids Special','Weekend'] derived from existing packages. Public /book page groups packages under category-named Card headers (Kids Special, Corporate, Weekend, BULK PARTY confirmed rendering). No 'Others' header present because all seeded packages currently have categories — correct conditional behaviour.

issues: Pre-existing (iter 8/9): Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning — cosmetic only.

action_items: Non-blocking: Packages.jsx card edit/delete icon buttons don't expose data-testid=pkg-edit-{id} / pkg-delete-{id}, which made programmatic edit testing harder. Consider adding for future automation.
Non-blocking cleanup: One leftover admin package 'TEST_Pub_19cea' from an earlier failed test run remains in DB (from before I fixed the type-enum in test). Safe to leave or delete.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend PackageIn.category is Optional[str] with default '' — correct. `data.model_dump()` includes category on PATCH so existing packages get category persisted after any edit — good.

Frontend Packages.jsx: filter derivation `list.map(p => (p.category||'').trim()).filter(Boolean)` correctly excludes empty categories from chip row. Chip counts recomputed inline — O(n·c) for small n it's fine.
PublicBook.jsx grouping IIFE is readable. Sort places 'Others' last correctly. Good.

Minor: chip data-testid `pkg-filter-{c}` uses raw category string which can contain spaces — works in playwright selectors but consider slugifying if categories ever contain special chars like '/' or quotes.
server.py still 1172 lines — pre-existing feedback to split into routers.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create/delete their own TEST_* packages within each test. One leftover TEST_Pub_19cea in DB from earlier failed run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Package.type is a strict Literal enum ['birthday','party','group','other'] — do NOT use 'kids' or other values in backend tests. Public catalog endpoint is /api/prebook/catalog (not /api/public/book). Frontend PublicBook route is /book and consumes prebook/catalog. Packages admin page has filter chips with data-testid=pkg-filter-{category exactly as stored, including spaces}. Add Package dialog testid = new-pkg-btn; category input testid = pkg-category with datalist#pkg-cat-suggest. Category pill uses secondary/15 bg on card header top-right.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature addition, not a bug. Feature verified end-to-end: PackageIn model accepts optional category → MongoDB persists → GET returns → filter chips + category pill on admin page → dialog datalist suggestions → public /book Card grouping by category with 'Others' fallback logic in place.
